From Cargo Pants to Grunge

From Cargo Pants to Grunge: the Best Spring Summer Fashion at Grand Central Shopping Centre

Spring is just around the corner, so as the weather begins to warm up, it’s time to take a look at the biggest spring summer trends for the year and see which new pieces you’ll need to invest in before the new season begins. Are you loving the practicality and edge of the cargo pants trend? Do you see yourself sporting a peplum top or are you more of a double denim person? No matter what trend you’ve got your eye on, you’ll be able to stock up on the pieces you need to rock a fresh new look right here at Grand Central Shopping Centre.

 

If you’re still unsure about what spring summer 2023 trend is right for you, we’ve whipped up a handy guide to the most popular summer fashion trends to help you figure out which trend will fit seamlessly into your spring summer wardrobe and where to find them here at Grand Central Shopping Centre.

Cargo Pants

Cargo pants were a huge trend last summer and it looks like they're here to stay! This trend is great for anyone who loves a more casual look and a nostalgic 90s style. The great part about this trend is that you can find cargo pants almost anywhere! Universal Storehave a great selection of cargo pants alongside their streetwear and you can also find cargo pants stocked at General Pants Co.amongst the most durable activewear! Pair your cargo pants with a simple crop top or your favourite bodysuit to stay cool whilst sporting the trend.

Grunge

Just when you thought the 90s resurgence was over, another key trend from the decade comes rolling in. If you like listening to Nirvana and The Cranberries over The Spice Girls and No Doubt, then you’ll be pleased to know that one of the biggest fashion trends for spring summer 2023 is grunge — think oversized band tees, distressed denim, and lots of plaid! City Beach have already jumped on the trend so you’ll be able to get everything you need to grunge-ify your wardrobe. Ally Fashion also have some great options if you’re looking for a more minimalist approach to the grunge trend. 

Denim

Noticed more and more people wearing the good old Canadian tuxedo with denim midi-skirts recently? That’s because one of the biggest summer fashion trends for 2023 is double denim! Whether you prefer a consistent shade of indigo in your double denim look or want to mix and match your shades, there’s so much room to play with the double denim trend so get ready to dive right in! Just Jeans have great denim pieces to add to your wardrobe like traditional blue, distressed black, and even acid wash. You may want to also check out Country Road. Their range of denim skirts, dresses, and shirts make the denim trend that much more exciting. 

Peplum

The final trend of the summer takes us from the 90s all the way up to the 2010s. A peplum is a short strip of fabric that flounces out from the waistline of a short jacket, skirt or dress and you may have noticed a few more peplums popping up on some of your favourite celebrities over the last few months. To adopt this trend, head into City Chic and take a look at the options they have in lighter fabrics. H&M also have some lovely peplum pieces that can work with anything from your new cargo pants or an a-line maxi skirt. 

Now you know what the biggest spring summer 2023 fashion trends are, you can come to Grand Central Shopping Centre and get shopping! All of these trends are here under one roof, so put together a shopping list and come visit us to get your cargo pants, peplum pieces, and go-to grunge staples for this spring and summer.
